title: Hydrazones in anion transporters: The detrimental effect of a second binding site
authors: Luis Martínez-Crespo; Lau Halgreen; Márcio Soares; Igor Marques; Vítor Félix; Hennie Valkenier
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酰腙类阴离子转运体的跨膜运输机制，核心是氯离子与膜脂的相互作用，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: Synthetic anion transporters can be developed using anion receptors that are able to bind the anion and stabilize it in the lipophilic interior of a bilayer membrane, and they usually contain functional groups with acidic NHs, such as ureas, thioureas and squaramides. To assess the suitability of acylhydrazones as a new functional group for the preparation of anion transporters, we have studied a family of thioureas functionalized with these and related functional groups. 1H NMR titrations and DFT calculations indicate that the thioureas bearing acylhydrazone groups behave as chloride receptors with two separate binding sites, of which the acylhydrazone binds weaker than the thiourea. Chloride transport studies show that the additional binding site has a detrimental effect on thiourea-based transporters, and this phenomenon is also observed for bis(thio)ureas with two separate binding sites. We propose that the presence of a second anion binding unit hinders the transport activity of the thiourea due to additional interactions with the phospholipids of the membrane. In agreement with this hypothesis, extensive molecular dynamics simulations suggest that the molecules will tend to be positioned in the water/lipid interface, driven by the interaction of the NHs of the thiourea and of the acylhydrazone groups with the POPC polar head groups and water molecules. Moreover, the interaction energies show that the poorest transporters have indeed the strongest interactions with the membrane phospholipids, inhibiting chloride transport. This detrimental effect of additional functional groups on transport activity should be considered when designing new ion transporters, unless these groups cooperatively promote anion recognition and transmembrane transport.
abstract_zh: 合成阴离子转运蛋白可以通过能够结合阴离子并使其稳定在双层膜脂溶性内部的阴离子受体来开发，这些受体通常含有酸性NH官能团，如脲、硫脲和方酰胺。为了评估酰腙作为制备阴离子转运蛋白新官能团的适用性，我们研究了一系列用这些及相关官能团功能化的硫脲。1H NMR滴定和DFT计算表明，带有酰腙基团的硫脲作为具有两个独立结合位点的氯离子受体，其中酰腙的结合能力弱于硫脲。氯离子转运研究表明，额外的结合位点对基于硫脲的转运蛋白有不利影响，这一现象也在具有两个独立结合位点的双（硫）脲中观察到。我们提出，第二个阴离子结合单元的存在通过其与膜磷脂的额外相互作用阻碍了硫脲的转运活性。与这一假设一致，广泛的分子动力学模拟表明，分子倾向于定位在水/脂质界面，由硫脲和酰腙基团的NH与POPC极性头部基团及水分子的相互作用驱动。此外，相互作用能显示，转运能力最差的分子确实与膜磷脂有最强的相互作用，从而抑制氯离子转运。在设计新的离子转运蛋白时，应考虑额外官能团对转运活性的这种不利影响，除非这些基团协同促进阴离子识别和跨膜转运。
